title: Lego Just Released Its First ‘The X-Files’ Set, Complete With Mulder and Scully Minifigures
summary: The 1,478-piece collectible celebrates one of television's most beloved sci-fi series, and includes a promotional gift while stock lasts.

title: John Galliano to Take Spotlight at Met Gala and Costume Institute Exhibition 16 Years After Antisemitic Rant
summary: The Costume Institute's "John Galliano: Horizons" exhibition in spring 2027 will make him only the third living designer to receive a solo exhibition at the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
